ctx.x: So the black teachers taught blacks, white teachers taught whites.

Right. But the thing is, we having so many professional musicians that could play, we were the ones who really had the band upstairs. Oh. And they would sneak upstairs to listen to us and they'd run them downstairs, you know. And they'd run them up to Freddie Crane sometimes, would write an arrangement, Freddie Crane the pianist. Yeah.
